Question: A 74-year-old man comes to the physician for evaluation of a skin lesion on his right arm. The lesion first appeared 3 months ago and has since been slowly enlarging. opb. Irreversible nuclear changes in the stratum basale
opc. Full-thickness basal to apical cell polarity
opd. Increased nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio in the stratum spinosum
